newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 17.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abidjan's Treichville market, partly destroyed by fire on Friday, will be demolished and rebuilt, Interior Minister Emile Constant Bombet says
- Ivory Coast and Ranger Oil sign production sharing agreement for research of CI-102 offshore bloc
- Secondary school teachers union SYNESCI starts 72-hour strike on Tuesday over pay and working conditions
- Planning and Development Ministry sets up committee to investigate industrial counterfeiting which undermines established companies and threatens to slow Ivory Coast's development
